[EN] Well, you made it through the Temple of Temerity!

You just might have the need of the level 58 uncommon glyphs I carry for sorcerers, archers, priests, and mystics! Bring me dire badges and we'll talk.

Warriors, slayers, berserkers, or lancers should speak to the big lug on my right.
[ES] ¡Vaya, lograste pasar por el Temple of Temerity!

¡Puede que necesites los uncommon glyphs de nivel 58 que tengo para sorcerers, archers, priests y mystics! Tráeme dire badges y hablaremos.

Warriors, slayers, berserkers o lancers deberían hablar con el grandulón a mi derecha.
